metadata.description: Local-first post-production automation for talking-head course video: rough cuts, dead-air removal, slides with a circular speaker cutout, and automatic slow zooms, delivered as one editable Premiere/Resolve timeline.

plugins.name: video-post
plugins.description: Automated post-production for talking-head video. rough-cut removes dead air, filler words and false starts, measuring real silence rather than guessing. slide-cutout puts slides on screen with the speaker as a circular corner cutout, timed from spoken cues. slow-zoom adds gentle push-ins on the lines that carry weight. All three write one editable FCP7 XML timeline for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, never a locked render. Runs locally; footage never leaves the machine.
